Accountant Job at Adams & Moore




        
    

        
        Adams & Moore is a top international accountancy, tax and professional advisory firm providing invaluable proactive advice to businesses across the globe. Adams and Moorehave supported public, private and third sector firms for over 75 years.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Arrangement: Office-Based

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a qualified or part-qualified accountant with five (5) or more years’ experience in preparation of statutory accounts and supporting compliance work for a portfolio of clients.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare financial statements for clients in line with the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and the UK GAAP.
	Prepare tax computations and tax returns for incorporated and unincorporated entities and individuals in line with the relevant tax laws.
	Access a number of bookkeeping software such as SAGE, QuickBooks and XERO and other sources for reports and other information required to completeassignedtasks.
	Carry out various account reconciliations, ensuring issues identified are properly investigated, resolved or queried.
	Identify key weaknesses in clients' financial reporting systems and recommend improvements required.
	Complete and send accounts packs for client signature.
	Prepare year-end journal of accounting adjustments and advise clients accordingly.
	Comply with the firm-wide quality control procedures.
	Coach junior team members and collaborate with other staff.


Requirements


	First Degree in Accounting, Economics or any other relevant fields, with at least 5 years of experience preparing statutory accounts.
	ACA or ACCA qualified or part-qualified.
	Strong understanding of IFRS and UK accounting standards
	Experience using accounting software (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage).
	Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
	Open to candidates nationwide: Qualified candidates residing outside Lagos are welcome to apply, provided they are willing and able to relocate to Lagos for the role.
	Remote and hybrid work arrangements are only available after probation.


Desirable:


	Experienced with cloud accounting systems.
	Experienced managing a small client portfolio.


Benefits


	Salary: N208,333 to N583,333 per month commensurate with experience and professional qualifications).
	Travel Assistance: Logistics and travel support are provided for qualified out-of-state candidates selected for final-stage physical interviews


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using " Application for Accountant Position" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Business Manager",
  "description": "Swift Consulting is a professional services firm specializing in Education Consulting, Human Resource Management, and Management Consulting. We connect top talent with leading organizations across industries.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Business Manager

Job Location: Shangisha, Magodo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Manager to oversee business operations, drive revenue growth, develop strategic partnerships, and ensure the efficient delivery of logistics services.
	The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, commercial, operational, and business development skills.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement strategies to grow the company&rsquo;s logistics business and market share.
	Oversee day-to-day business operations and ensure efficient service delivery.
	Identify and pursue new business opportunities, clients, and strategic partnerships.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Monitor sales performance, revenue, profitability, and operational costs.
	Develop and manage business budgets and ensure effective resource utilization.
	Lead, motivate, and manage teams to achieve business objectives.
	Monitor industry trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
	Negotiate contracts and commercial agreements with clients and partners.
	Prepare regular business performance reports for management.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
